_about.note: Variants deliberately marked as not differing in everyday written register. Inheriting the base language's tier for these is CORRECT, not a placeholder -- which is the whole reason this state is separate from `untested`. Only claims we are prepared to defend belong here; everything else stays untested and countable.
_about.source: ru-BY is the worked example in docs/01. Nothing has been added beyond what that document decided.
_about.warning: Do not bulk-fill this file to make coverage numbers look better. An unfilled gap that is visible is worth more than a filled one that is wrong.

ru-BY.note: Russian as written in Belarus does not differ from Russian as written in Russia in everyday register. There is no marker set to author, so inheriting `ru` is the right answer rather than a fallback. This is a claim about the written standard, not about Belarusian (`be`), which is a different language entirely.
